terms.name: note
terms.definition: A piece of text with an id.

rules.response: shall return every note in creation order

rules.trigger: the user creates a note with non-empty text
rules.response: shall return the note with the next id, the first being 1

rules.trigger: the text of a new note is empty
rules.response: shall refuse to create the note

examples:
Feature: Notes
  Rule: R-1
    @R-1 @E-1
    Scenario: List returns notes in creation order
      Given notes "a" then "b" were created
      When the user lists notes
      Then the response status is 200
      And the notes are returned in the order "a", "b"

  Rule: R-2
    @R-2 @E-2
    Scenario: A created note gets the next id
      When the user creates a note with text "a"
      Then the response status is 201
      And the note is returned with id 1

  Rule: R-3
    @R-3 @E-3
    Scenario: Empty text is refused
      When the user creates a note with text ""
      Then the creation is refused
contract:
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: notes, version: '1'}
paths:
  /notes:
    get:
      operationId: listNotes
      x-rules: [R-1]
      responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
    post:
      operationId: createNote
      x-rules: [R-2, R-3]
      responses:
        '201': {description: created}
        '400': {description: empty text}

questions.text: Is text of only spaces empty?
Which status for an empty text?
